description: Checks a supplier's payout address before you pay it. Checks that the address is well formed (EVM), screens it against the OFAC SDN list of digital currency addresses, and compares it with the payout addresses this account has verified for the same supplier_id. Returns verified, a risk score from 0.00 (safe) to 1.00 (high risk), and an action: PROCEED, REVIEW or BLOCK. The first payout to a supplier has no baseline yet, so historical_match is WARN. Three calls a day per IP are free.

payout_address.description: EVM address the supplier is paid to.
payout_address.title: Payout Address

name: verify_payout
